data.narrative:
The Red Metal Company is a seed-stage Climate & Energy venture founded by Jackson Switzer that has raised $10M to date. The comparable universe in Climate & Energy spans 9 private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) and 1 public company (LNZA), though same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables are sparse.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: Stage-Progression. Using the $10M total raised as a base value proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, this method implies a $25M valuation. The Peer-Median approach could not be applied; while 9 same-sector peers exist, zero qualify as same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables, falling short of the minimum three-datapoint threshold required for a reliable median.

The triangulated range is $21M to $29M, with a median of $25M. This narrow range reflects the methodological constraint—only one technique is statistically defensible given data availability. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific company's risk profile and market conditions, and the absence of direct peer valuation comparables at seed stage in Climate & Energy to cross-check the magnitude of the step-up. Any valuation within the derived range should be treated as illustrative pending expanded comparable data or investor term sheets.
